blocks.text: Learning to ski is one of the most humbling experiences an adult can undergo (that is one reason to start young). After all, an adult has been walking for a long time; he knows where his feet are; he knows how to put one foot in front of the other in order to get somewhere. But as soon as he puts skis on his feet, it looks as though he had to learn to walk all over again. He slips and slips, falls down, has trouble getting up, gets his skis crossed, tumbles again, and generally looks and feels like a fool.

readingSentences.english: Financial literacy is a critical skill in modern economic life.
readingSentences.korean: 금융 이해력은 현대 경제생활에서 대단히 중요한 필수 역량이다.

readingSentences.english: Understanding budgeting, compound interest, and debt management prevents financial crises.
readingSentences.korean: 예산 수립과 복리 이자, 그리고 부채 관리를 제대로 이해하는 것은 재정적 위기를 막아준다.

readingSentences.english: Living below one's means and investing early builds long-term security.
readingSentences.korean: 자신의 수입 이하로 생활하며 일찍부터 투자하는 습관은 장기적인 경제적 안정을 구축해 준다.

readingSentences.english: Wise money management grants freedom and peace of mind.
readingSentences.korean: 현명한 돈 관리는 자유와 마음의 평안을 가져다준다.
